defs.def: to one side; out of the way 到旁边；在旁边

ex.s: He quickly   63   （throw）his tools aside, and started running, arms out.
ex.t: 他迅速   63  （throw）扔下工具，张开双臂跑过去。

ex.s: brushed asideB. put to the test
ex.t: brushed aside（撇开；不理会）　B. put to the test（经受考验）

ex.s: A family day out is an opportunity to put aside work, school and other commitments and spend quality time together.
ex.t: 家庭出游是一个把工作、学业和其他事务放到一边，共度美好时光的机会。

ex.s: Facing the problems of environment pollution and overdevelopment, some national parks have been set aside to protect both natural features and wildlife.
ex.t: 用你之前发现的形容词来描述这些职业。

ex.s: Nanxiang aside, the best Xiao long bao have a fine skin, allowing them ____41____ (lift) out of the steamer basket without allowing them tearing or spilling any of ____42____ (they) contents.
ex.t: 除了南翔，最好的小笼包皮薄，能让它们（第41空，lift）出蒸笼而不撕裂或洒出（第42空，they）任何馅料。

defs.def: to be used later 留；存

ex.s: Although this could likewise involve putting aside money for your university education, it also means investing in yourself.
ex.t: 尽管这同样可能涉及为你的大学教育存钱，但它也意味着投资自己。

ex.s: In addition to putting money aside for university education, it also means 6________________.
ex.t: 除了为大学教育存钱之外，这还意味着……

ex.s: His knowledge and devotion aside, people who knew Lu Gusun had great respect for his integrity.
ex.t: 除了他的学识和奉献精神，认识陆谷孙的人还非常敬重他的人格正直。

defs.def: something that a character in a play says to the audience, but which the other characters on stage are not intended to hear 戏剧

ex.s: Shirley Fitzgerald, the city’s official historian, told me that in its rush to modernity in the 1970s, Sydney swept aside much of its past, including many of its finest buildings.
ex.t: 悉尼官方历史学家Shirley Fitzgerald告诉我，在20世纪70年代急于现代化的过程中，悉尼抛弃了过去的很多东西，包括许多精美的建筑。

ex.s: First I cut the tomatoes into pieces but put them aside.
ex.t: 首先把西红柿切块，然后放在一边。

ex.s: Data shows that kids and teens who do read frequently, compared to infrequent readers, have more books in the home, more books purchased for them, parents who read more often, and parents who set aside time for them to read.
ex.t: 数据显示，与不常阅读的孩子和青少年相比，经常阅读的孩子和青少年家里有更多的书，为他们购买的书籍更多，父母阅读更频繁，并且父母会为他们留出阅读时间。

defs.def: a remark, often made in a low voice, which is not intended to be heard by everyone present 低声说的话
a remark that is not directly connected with the main subject that is being discussed 离题话
